batch_expiry_status.name: batch_expiry_status
batch_expiry_status.value: ("point_batches"."expiry_status" = 'known' AND "point_batches"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("point_batches"."expiry_status" IN ('unknown', 'never') AND "point_batches"."expires_at" IS NULL)

point_tx_direction.name: point_tx_direction
point_tx_direction.value: ("point_transactions"."kind" = 'credit' AND "point_transactions"."points" > 0) OR ("point_transactions"."kind" IN ('debit', 'expire') AND "point_transactions"."points" < 0) OR ("point_transactions"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "point_transactions"."points" <> 0)

promotion_valid_range.name: promotion_valid_range
promotion_valid_range.value: "promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"

reward_value_present.name: reward_value_present
reward_value_present.value: "reward_records"."points" IS NOT NULL OR "reward_records"."cash_minor" IS NOT NULL

reward_nonnegative.name: reward_nonnegative
reward_nonnegative.value: ("reward_records"."points" IS NULL OR "reward_records"."points" >= 0) AND ("reward_records"."cash_minor" IS NULL OR "reward_records"."cash_minor" >= 0) AND ("reward_records"."point_value_micros" IS NULL OR "reward_records"."point_value_micros" >= 0) AND ("reward_records"."cost_minor" IS NULL OR "reward_records"."cost_minor" >= 0) AND ("reward_records"."foregone_value_minor" IS NULL OR "reward_records"."foregone_value_minor" >= 0)
